:::{#exm-equal-almost-everywhere}
#### A function that differs from $0$ at one point

Let $S = \reals$ with the [Lebesgue measure](#def-lebesgue-measure) $\measure$.
Let $f(s) = 1$ if $s = 0$, and $f(s) = 0$ otherwise.
The [set](sets.qmd#def-set) $\set{s : f(s) \neq 0} = \set{0}$ has [measure zero](#def-measure-zero),
so $f = 0$ [almost everywhere](#def-almost-everywhere) by @def-equal-almost-everywhere.

:::
